diagnosis.preamble: Times are seconds of game time: one native tick is 34 ms, and every model decision holds one of six inputs for 15 ticks (0.51 s); the game pauses while the model decides. Gravity can be flipped only while standing on a floor or ceiling.

harness.trigger_rule: every model decision: the request is rendered from the state with the 9x9 local rows showing solid and spike cells as clear; the trigger is the first decision at which this changes the request (decision 0 from the start)
harness.changed_artifact: localSolidRows in the model request (solid '#' and spike '!' cells rendered as clear '.')

controller.trigger_rule: every model decision whose selected input has a horizontal direction (left, right, flip_left, flip_right): left and right are exchanged after the selection; the trigger is the first such decision
controller.changed_artifact: native input sent to the game (left and right exchanged; flip edges kept)

scenario.win_rule: the player enters a room other than [113,105] Welcome Aboard and [114,105] Conundrum
